evidence: The building shows a large foreshortened snow-covered roof slope (rows 8-36) above the vertical log front wall (rows 37-60). style.evidence: The cabin uses 5+ shading tones on both the snow roof (white to slate blue-grey with scalloped snowdrift texture) and the wooden log walls (warm tan to deep brown with horizontal log joints and vertical wood grain on the door). Outlines are dark brown on wood and dark blue-grey on snow/stone, matching the reference richness.
